import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'docs/experiments/2026-11-03-staggered-bottleneck/tools'))
import seal_case as seal
specs=[('20261103_midflow_F2_screen73_6','future_resources_F2_screen73_6','F','raw_F2screen6_post5_v1'),('20261103_midflow_C5_screen73_6','local_gap_trajectory_C5_screen73_6','C5','raw_C5screen6_post5_v1')]
plans=[]
for bname,sname,candidate,diagnostic in specs:
    batch=root/'tmp/staggered_bottleneck'/bname;stage=root/'docs/experiments/2026-11-03-midflow-staggered'/sname
    proof=seal.read(stage/'evidence_complete6.tar.verification.json');meta=seal.read(stage/'evidence_complete6.tar.manifest.json');archive=stage/'evidence_complete6.tar.gz'
    assert proof['cases_verified']==proof['protocol_verified']==proof['physical_safe_count']==proof['all_completed_count']==6
    assert not proof['original_paths_required'] and not proof['original_repository_reads'] and proof['archive_original_bytes_compared']
    assert seal.sha(archive)==meta['sha256'] and archive.stat().st_size==meta['bytes']
    records=seal.read(batch/'manifest.json');protocol=seal.read(batch/'protocol.json');assert len(records)==len(protocol['tasks'])==6
    keys=lambda r:(r['candidate'],r['flow'],r['seed'],r['scenario'],r['mode'])
    assert len({keys(r) for r in records})==6 and {keys(r) for r in records}=={keys(r) for r in protocol['tasks']}
    audit=root/'docs/experiments/2026-11-03-midflow-staggered/diagnosis'/diagnostic
    out=stage/'raw_pruning';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False);(out/'mechanism_provenance').mkdir();index=[]
    for r in records:
        assert r['candidate']==candidate and r['flow'] in (1500.,1750.,2000.) and r['seed'] in (73,74) and r['scenario']=='lane_drop' and r['mode']=='transform'
        assert r['safe'] is True and r['all_completed'] is True and r['status']=='drained' and r['returncode']==0 and r['seal_status']=='verified'
        folder=Path(r['evidence_dir']);saved=seal.read(folder/'seal.json');seal.verify(folder,False)
        provenance=audit/(Path(r['case_output']).name+'_provenance.json');mp=seal.read(provenance)
        assert mp['case_dir']==r['run_dir'] and mp['positions_sha256']==saved['originals']['positions.jsonl.gz']['sha256'] and mp['window_complete'] and 'complete+5' in ' '.join(mp['limitations'])
        (out/'mechanism_provenance'/provenance.name).write_bytes(provenance.read_bytes())
        for name,e in saved['originals'].items():
            p=Path(r['run_dir'])/name
            assert not e.get('missing') and p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size==e['bytes'] and seal.sha(p)==e['sha256']
        index.append(dict(candidate=r['candidate'],flow=r['flow'],seed=r['seed'],scenario=r['scenario'],mode=r['mode'],run_dir=r['run_dir'],evidence_dir=r['evidence_dir'],keep_full_raw=r['seed']==73,originals=saved['originals'],post5_provenance_sha256=seal.sha(provenance)))
    assert sum(r['keep_full_raw'] for r in index)==3
    seal.write(out/'raw_index_before_pruning.json',index)
    source=audit/'audit_raw_midflow_source.py';(out/'mechanism_provenance'/source.name).write_bytes(source.read_bytes())
    plans.append((batch,stage,out,index,meta))
summaries=[]
for batch,stage,out,index,meta in plans:
    changes=[]
    for r in index:
        if r['keep_full_raw']:
            changes.append({**r,'deleted':[],'bytes_released':0});continue
        changed=seal.prune_raw(Path(r['run_dir']),batch,r['originals'],verified=True)
        assert set(changed['deleted'])==set(seal.RAW_FILES);seal.verify(Path(r['evidence_dir']),False)
        changes.append({**r,**changed})
    for r in index:
        for name,e in r['originals'].items():
            p=Path(r['run_dir'])/name
            assert (p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size==e['bytes'] and seal.sha(p)==e['sha256']) if r['keep_full_raw'] else not p.exists()
    result=dict(cases=changes,pruned_successful_cases=3,retained_full_raw_cases=3,bytes_released=sum(r['bytes_released'] for r in changes),archive_sha256=meta['sha256'],post5_audit_complete_for_all_cases=True,only_exact_seed74_success_raw_pruned=True,no_recursive_delete=True,failed_cases_pruned=0,original_manifest_and_seals_unchanged=True,old_batches_untouched=True)
    seal.write(out/'pruning_verification.json',result);summaries.append(dict(stage=stage.name,**{k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='cases'}))
print(json.dumps(summaries))
